query: WanVideoWrapper 1.3.9 causes massive VRAM increase/OOM vs 1.3.6 on Wan 2.2 14B I2V with blockswap 40 (needed blocks up from 20 to 35; 101-frame gen drops to 41 frames on 4090); 'blocks to swap' log line disappeared.

desired.outcome: Confirmed workarounds: clear Triton caches (~/.triton and %TEMP%/torchinductor_<user>) as kijai instructs, and/or revert to wrapper 1.3.6 (14.5GB vs 23.1GB VRAM measured); blockswap itself was working fine — log line removed in refactor.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: Confirmed workarounds: clear Triton caches (~/.triton and %TEMP%/torchinductor_<user>) as kijai instructs, and/or revert to wrapper 1.3.6 (14.5GB vs 23.1GB VRAM measured); blockswap itself was working fine — log line removed in refactor.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Distinguish a real wrapper-version VRAM regression from stale Triton/inductor caches, and know the missing 'blocks to swap' log line was just removed in a refactor (blockswap still works).
